name_zh: 查韦斯/马杜罗/石油政治：石油民粹再分配与玻利瓦尔革命
name_en: Chavez/Maduro/Oil Politics: Oil Populist Redistribution & Bolivarian Revolution
description_zh: 乌戈·查韦斯 (1954-2013) 委内瑞拉总统 (1999-2013)，尼古拉斯·马杜罗 (1962-) 2013- 继位，玻利瓦尔革命核心。核心治理模式：石油租金再分配 — PDVSA 国有化/石油收入直拨社会任务(健康/教育/住房/粮食)/反帝反美/拉美一体化(ALBA/石油换医生)/21 世纪社会主义。2010s 油价暴跌/制裁/恶性通胀/移民潮/马杜罗争议连任/临时总统瓜伊多/人道危机。体现 M168 石油民粹再分配 — 以"石油国有化+社会任务再分配+反帝意识形态+军民融合"四位一体，在石油诅咒/美洲地缘/意识形态极化中构建民粹再分配政权。
description_en: Hugo Chavez (1954-2013) Venezuela President (1999-2013), Nicolas Maduro (1962-) succeeded 2013-, Bolivarian Revolution core. Core governance model: oil rent redistribution — PDVSA nationalization/oil revenue direct-funded social missions (health/education/housing/food)/anti-imperialist anti-US/Latin American integration (ALBA/oil-for-doctors)/21st century socialism. 2010s oil price crash/sanctions/hyperinflation/migration wave/Maduro disputed reelection/interim president Guaido/humanitarian crisis. Exemplifies M168 Oil Populist Redistribution — quaternity of 'oil nationalization + social mission redistribution + anti-imperial ideology + civil-military fusion' constructing populist redistribution regime amid oil curse/Western Hemisphere geopolitics/ideological polarization.
reason_zh: 查韦斯非单纯民粹主义者，而是"石油租金+社会任务+反帝意识形态"三位一体革命政治家。以 PDVSA 掌控石油命脉，以社会任务绕过腐败官僚直达贫民，以反美凝聚拉美左翼。M168 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M193 后冲突修复(秘鲁/委内瑞拉反对派)、M189 大人制(蒙博图)，核心在于"石油租金直拨民生+反帝凝聚区域左翼+军民融合守卫政权"的委内瑞拉石油民粹范式。
reason_en: Chavez not mere populist but 'oil rent + social missions + anti-imperial ideology' trinity revolutionary statesman. PDVSA controlled oil lifeline, social missions bypassed corrupt bureaucracy reaching poor directly, anti-US rallied Latin American left. M168 distinct from M169 Post-Oil Transition (Saudi), M193 Post-Conflict Repair (Peru/Venezuela opposition), M189 Big Man (Mobutu), core: 'oil rent direct to livelihoods + anti-imperial rallies regional left + civil-military fusion guards regime' Venezuelan oil populism paradigm.
steps_zh: PDVSA 国有化与石油主权：1999 新宪法/2002-03 罢工镇压/2006 全面国有化/合资重谈/石油收入纳入国家预算
社会任务再分配体系：使命罗宾逊(扫盲)/使命巴里奥阿德恩托(古巴医生社区医疗)/使命比维恩达(住房)/使命阿尔门塔里奥(粮食)，直拨零中介
反帝意识形态与拉美一体化：ALBA/石油换医生/苏克雷虚拟货币/南方银行/联合国/不结盟/反美外交/拉美左翼领袖
军民融合与政权守卫：国民警卫队/民兵/集体/公社/军队商业/情报/反政变/2002 未遂政变/2019 瓜伊多挑战/军队忠诚
油价暴跌与危机演变：2014 油价暴跌/2017 制裁/恶性通胀 100万%+/500万+ 移民/人道危机/马杜罗争议连任/2020s 部分验美元化/PDVSA 重组
steps_en: PDVSA nationalization & oil sovereignty: 1999 new constitution/2002-03 strike crushed/2006 full nationalization/JV renegotiation/oil revenue into national budget

Social mission redistribution system: Mission Robinson (literacy)/Mission Barrio Adentro (Cuban doctors community health)/Mission Vivienda (housing)/Mission Alimentario (food), direct zero-intermediary
Anti-imperial ideology & Latin American integration: ALBA/oil-for-doctors/Sucre virtual currency/Bank of the South/UN/Non-Aligned/anti-US diplomacy/Latin American left leader
Civil-military fusion & regime defense: National Guard/militias/collectives/communes/military commerce/intel/anti-coup/2002 failed coup/2019 Guaido challenge/military loyalty
Oil price crash & crisis evolution: 2014 oil crash/2017 sanctions/hyperinflation 1M%+/5M+ migrants/humanitarian crisis/Maduro disputed reelection/2020s partial dollarization/PDVSA restructuring
expected_zh: 以"石油国有化+社会任务+反帝意识形态+军民融合"四位一体，在石油诅咒/美洲地缘/意识形态极化中构建民粹再分配政权，留下石油依赖未解/制度脆弱/人道危机的警世遗产。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'oil nationalization + social missions + anti-imperial ideology + civil-military fusion' constructs populist redistribution regime amid oil curse/Western Hemisphere geopolitics/ideological polarization, leaving cautionary legacy of unresolved oil dependency/institutional fragility/humanitarian crisis.

case_en: 1999 elected/1999 new constitution/2002 coup/strike/2006 nationalization/2013 Chavez death/Maduro succeeds/2014 oil crash/2017 sanctions/2019 Guaido/2020s partial dollarization/humanitarian crisis continues, oil populism paradigm sustainability test.
